Patch release focused on preserving page state and improving macOS disk access setup.

- Kept previously visited feature pages mounted when switching sections.
- Preserved in-progress results and local UI state when returning to a page.
- Kept the HUD mounted after first use so reopening it no longer resets its state.
- Improved Full Disk Access detection across protected macOS folders.
- Added an in-app restart action so newly enabled disk access can take effect.

Important: users migrating from an earlier ad-hoc signed build must remove the old StowMind entry from Full Disk Access, add `/Applications/StowMind.app` again, and restart the app once.

The macOS download is Developer ID signed and notarized.
